children: Cannabis company High Tide has contacted the Nasdaq Stock Exchange and TSX Venture Exchange to assess how federal rescheduling could affect the exchange's respective listing policies and, ultimately, its ability to pursue opportunities in the U.S. adult-use cannabis sector. The outreach follows a Drug Enforcement Administration administrative hearing held between June 29 and July 15 on moving cannabis from Schedule I to Schedule III.
